descriptions.zh: 虚空虫的生物学特性和繁殖模式值得进一步研究。
descriptions.en: The biology and reproductive patterns of the Voidworms warrant further study.

descriptions.zh: [cutholoid_under_radar.GetName]小行星不可貌相。我们需要派遣一支小有规模的军队前去，在[this.GetName]科研船永远离开我们之前将其救出。
descriptions.en: The asteroid [cutholoid_under_radar.GetName] is not what it seems to be. We should approach with a sizable military force and attempt to recover our science ship [this.GetName] before it is gone for good.

sections.zh: 轨道上有$COUNT$/$REQUIRED$支战斗力至少为600的舰队。
sections.en: Has $COUNT$/$REQUIRED$ fleet(s) with at least 600 fleet power in orbit.

descriptions.zh: [cutholoid_under_radar.GetName]小行星不可貌相。我们有了合适的科技，可以将其整个捕获并在[this.GetName]永远离开我们之前将其轻易地救出。
descriptions.en: The asteroid [cutholoid_under_radar.GetName] is not what it seems to be. With the right technology, we could capture it entirely and easily recover our science ship [this.GetName] before it is gone for good.

descriptions.zh: 我们摧毁了一只躲在小行星中的巨型生物。收获它的尸体也许对我们很有价值。
descriptions.en: We have destroyed a massive creature hidden inside an asteroid. Harvesting its remains could prove valuable to us.

descriptions.zh: 岩居兽的小行星外壳是一件令人印象深刻的生物工程杰作。我们还有很多可以向它们学习的。
descriptions.en: The asteroidal shell structure of the Cutholoid is an impressive piece of biological engineering. There is more for us to learn from them.

descriptions.zh: 在[contact_system.GetName]发现了一具[met_critter.GetSpaceFaunaName]的尸体。对这些野生生物遗骸的研究将加深我们对这些太空生物的了解。
descriptions.en: The carcass of a [met_critter.GetSpaceFaunaName] was discovered in [contact_system.GetName]. Studying these remains in the wild will broaden our understanding of these spaceborne creatures.

descriptions.zh: 在[this.GetName]内的某处探测到了一个失踪已久的海盗§Y珍宝藏库§!。谁也不知道里面到底藏有多少宝贝……
descriptions.en: A long-lost pirate's §YTreasure Trove§! has been detected to be somewhere on [this.GetName]. Who knows what riches it may contain...

descriptions.zh: 有一支海盗舰队在追寻着[this.GetName]的§Y珍宝藏库§!！
descriptions.en: A pirate fleet is after the §YTreasure Trove§! on [this.GetName]!

descriptions.zh: 我们对轨道胶囊内包含的海图进行了初步分析，发现许多天体的位置并不在我们母星系内。还需要一些时间才能提取准确的坐标。
descriptions.en: Our initial analysis of the chart inside of the orbital capsule revealed the location of several celestial bodies not present in our home system. It will take time to extract the exact coordinates.

descriptions.zh:
§H星国图志§!引导我们来到一个粉碎星球。我们探测到一条非自然形成的隧道深深钻入了行星最大地壳板块。相信星图的下一部分就隐藏在里面，但需要仔细挖掘才能获取。

可以用工程船来建造必要的设备从而发掘出这块星图碎片。
descriptions.en:
The §HCelestial Chart§! has led us to a shattered world. We detected an unnatural tunnel drilled into the largest slab of planetary crust. We believe that the next piece of our chart is hidden within, but accessing it will require careful excavation.

A construction ship would be able to build the necessary equipment to extract the piece.

descriptions.zh: 从破碎行星的残骸中挖掘出胶囊后，我们需要破译其中的导航数据。这个过程需要交叉参照我们的制图数据库，并将标记的天体与已知星系进行比对。
descriptions.en: After excavating the capsule from the remains of the shattered planet, we need to decipher the navigation data within. This process will require cross-referencing our cartographic database and charting the marked celestial bodies against known systems.

descriptions.zh:
除了乙特人标本，我们还发现了一个用于保存标本的复杂展示柜的先进设计。

研究该蓝图中使用的技术可能会帮助未来的保护和展览工作。
descriptions.en:
Alongside the Ytterite specimen, we discovered an advanced design for a complex display cabinet that would aid in its preservation.

Researching the techniques used in this blueprint will likely aid future conservation and exhibition efforts.

descriptions.zh:
在探索宇宙的过程中，我们收集了无数独特的文物和文化奇观。这些标本将激励民众，使我们的展览成为第一个展示和保护所有星系知识领域的展览。

建造一个§H博物天枢§!正是为了这一目的。
descriptions.en:
Throughout our exploration of the cosmos, we have collected countless unique artifacts and cultural oddities. These specimens will inspire the populace and make our exhibition the first to showcase and conserve all fields of galactic knowledge.

Building a §HGrand Archive§! would suit this purpose.

descriptions.zh:
位于[This.GetName]的地下基地对轨道轰炸具有很强的抵抗力，但只要有足够的时间和火力，我们舰队就能将其摧毁。基地被摧毁后，我们可以搜寻废墟，以回收§H星国图志§!碎片和其他贵重物品。

战术顾问提醒，这种做法可能会给黑针足够的时间呼叫增援。
descriptions.en:
The underground base on [This.GetName] is highly resistant to orbital bombardment, but with enough time and firepower, it is possible to destroy it with our fleet alone. Once the base has been neutralized, we can search the ruins to recover the §HCelestial Chart§! piece and any other valuables.

Tactical advisors caution that this approach may allow the Black Needle sufficient time to call for reinforcements.

sections.zh: 轨道上有$COUNT$/$REQUIRED$支战斗力至少为2000的舰队。
sections.en: Has $COUNT$/$REQUIRED$ fleet(s) with fleet power greater than or equal to 2000 in orbit.

descriptions.zh:
位于[This.GetName]的地下基地对轨道轰炸具有很强的抵抗力，但只要有足够的时间和火力，我们舰队就能将其摧毁。基地被摧毁后，我们可以搜寻废墟，以回收§H星国图志§!碎片和其他贵重物品。

战术顾问提醒，这种做法可能会给黑针足够的时间呼叫增援。
descriptions.en:
The underground base on [This.GetName] is highly resistant to orbital bombardment, but with enough time and firepower, it is possible to destroy it with our fleet alone. Once the base has been neutralized, we can search the ruins to recover the §HCelestial Chart§! piece and any other valuables.

Tactical advisors caution that this approach may allow the Black Needle sufficient time to call for reinforcements.

sections.zh: 轨道上有$COUNT$/$REQUIRED$支战斗力至少为1000的舰队。
sections.en: Has $COUNT$/$REQUIRED$ fleet(s) with fleet power greater than or equal to 1000 in orbit.

descriptions.zh:
[FromFrom.GetName]地下基地受到大量军队和安保无人机的保护。在行星表面部署军队将使我们能够迅速占领基地，给§Y黑针§!几乎没有反应的机会。

一旦我们控制了基地，就可以发掘星图胶囊以及海盗积累的任何其他不义之财。
descriptions.en:
The underground base on [FromFrom.GetName] is protected by a significant number of troops and security drones. Deploying armies on the planet's surface would allow us to take over the base quickly, giving little opportunity for the §YBlack Needle§! to react.

Once we have secured the base, we can extract the chart capsule and any other ill-gotten goods the pirates have accumulated.

descriptions.zh: 海盗过度依赖偷窃和改装技术，这导致他们的基地容易受到渗透。可以让一艘科研船从轨道上入侵[FromFrom.GetName]的网络，伪装成§Y黑针§!运输船，并声称受荷仁船长的命令，说服他们移交星图胶囊，避免不必要的流血事件。
descriptions.en: The pirates' over-reliance on stolen and repurposed tech has left their base vulnerable to infiltration. A single research ship could hack the network on [FromFrom.GetName] from orbit, masquerading as a §YBlack Needle§! transport vessel under orders of Captain Hoo. This might convince them to transfer custody of the map capsule without needless bloodshed.

descriptions.zh: 我们从§Y黑针§!基地获取了星图胶囊，接下来的任务是解密其中的数据，并将新信息整合到§H星国图志§!中。
descriptions.en: With the capsule taken from the §YBlack Needle§! base, we are tasked with decrypting the data within and integrating the new information into the §HCelestial Chart§!.

descriptions.zh:
根据我们的调查，我们认为§H星国图志§!的下一部分隐藏在[this.GetName]的早已沦为废墟的定居点中。

鉴于其他胶囊的结构十分坚固，我们可以假设它在最近的轰炸中留存下来。
descriptions.en:
Based on our investigation, we believe that the next piece of the §HCelestial Chart§! is hidden somewhere within the ruined settlement on [this.GetName].

Given the sturdy construction of the other capsules, we can assume that it has survived the recent bombardment.

descriptions.zh: 从斯密吉卜定居点废墟中发掘出胶囊后，剩下的就是解密里面的数据，并完成§H星国图志§!。我们很快就会发现§H奈斯船长§!的踪迹尽头等待着我们的是什么。
descriptions.en: After extracting the capsule from the ruins of Smeegibb's settlement, all that remains is to decrypt the data inside and complete the §HCelestial Chart§!. We will soon discover what awaits us at the end of §HCaptain Ness§!' trail.

descriptions.zh: 我们按照§H星国图志§!指引，来到了[this.solar_system.GetName]星系中一个被虫群寄生的§H星门§!。必须先处理这些生物，才能重新激活星门，看看另一边有什么。
descriptions.en: We have followed the §HCelestial Chart§! to an infested §HGateway§! in the [this.solar_system.GetName] system. These creatures must be dealt with before we can reactivate the Gate and see what is on the other side.

descriptions.zh: [this.solar_system.GetName]星系中虚空虫的尸骸显示出异常读数。我们的扫描仪似乎在一个垂垂死去的三头虫中探测到生命迹象。我们应该派遣一艘科研船去进一步调查。
descriptions.en: The remains of the Voidworms in [this.solar_system.GetName] are showing unusual readings. Our scanners seem to detect signs of life within one of decaying Troikas. We should send a Science Ship to investigate this further.

descriptions.zh: [FromFromFrom.System.GetName]的星门处于休眠状态。当接近这座古老的建筑时，§Y星国图志§!提供了一系列关于这项失落技术的知识。理解这种古老的交通方式可能会在其他冒险中证明有用。
descriptions.en: The Gateway in [FromFromFrom.System.GetName] is inactive. When approaching the ancient structure, the §YCelestial Chart§! provided a series of insights in this lost technology. Understanding this ancient method of transportation will likely prove useful in other ventures.

descriptions.zh: 作为§H星国图志§!上的最终目的地，[this.solar_system.GetName]中的休眠§H星门§!可能是通往某个非常重要的地点。
descriptions.en: As the final destination on the §HCelestial Chart§!, the inactive §HGateway§! in [this.solar_system.GetName] likely leads to something of great importance.

descriptions.zh: 作为§H星国图志§!上的最终目的地，[this.solar_system.GetName]中的休眠§H星门§!可能是通往某个非常重要的地点。
descriptions.en: As the final destination on the §HCelestial Chart§!, the inactive §HGateway§! in [this.solar_system.GetName] likely leads to something of great importance.

titles.en: Last Stand of the Black Needle

descriptions.zh: 在对[root.GetName]的恒星系进行大规模破坏性攻击后，黑针仍然维持着对§H奈斯船长的宝藏§!的封锁。他们已经耗尽了大部分资源，现在处于脆弱状态。如果我们在这里击败他们，他们的整个组织必然会崩溃，让我们可以自由地夺取宝藏。
descriptions.en: Following extensive sabotage attacks on [root.GetName] systems, the Black Needle have maintained their blockade around §HCaptain Ness's Hoard§!. They have exhausted much of their resources, and are now in a vulnerable position. If we defeat them here, their wider organization will surely crumble, allowing us to freely claim the treasure.

descriptions.zh:
§H奈斯船长的宝藏§!近在咫尺了。

尽管它看起来被遗弃了，但建筑物的许多系统仍在运行。考虑到§H奈斯船长§!的传说性质，我们应该警惕预料之外的安全措施。

这个宝库的唯一入口在其中央舱口处有一个凹槽。我们可以将§H星国图志§!插入这里，打开这个神秘的设施。
descriptions.en:
§HCaptain Ness's Hoard§! is ours to take.

Despite its abandoned appearance, many of the building's systems are active. Given the alleged nature of §HCaptain Ness§!, we should be cautious of unexpected security measures.

The singular entrance of the treasure trove has an indent carved into its central hatch. We can insert the §HCelestial Chart§! here to open this mysterious facility.

descriptions.zh: 我们在寻找虚空虫疫的治疗方法方面取得了突破性进展。唯一需要的是处于活跃繁殖状态的虚空三头虫的生殖腺。
descriptions.en: We have made a breakthrough discovery in the search for a cure to the Voidworm Plague. All that is required are the reproductive glands of a Voidworm Troika in an active state of fertility.

descriptions.zh:
这种虚空三头虫的残骸可以收获其具有繁殖能力的生殖腺。

这些器官将极大地扩展我们对这些生物的生物学理解，并帮助我们彻底消灭虚空虫疫。
descriptions.en:
The remains of this Voidworm Troika can be harvested for their fertile reproductive glands.

These organs would greatly expand our understanding of the creatures' biology and assist in eradicating the Voidworm Plague once and for all.

descriptions.zh:
在我们对新克隆生物进行训练的过程中，一只受伤的太空变形虫使用了一种新技术击败了对手。变形虫的鞭毛能够从训练伙伴的天然防御中吸取营养和物质，用它们来修补自身盔甲上的漏洞，并恢复战斗力。

对这种现象的进一步研究可能会揭示太空变形虫生物学的一个新元素，可以对其进行增强，从而开发出一种新的物种特异性突变。
descriptions.en:
During our training process of newly cloned organisms, an injured Space Amoeba used a novel technique to defeat its opponent. The Amoeba's flagella were able to siphon nutrients and materials from its training partner's natural defenses, using them to patch holes in their own armor and regain fighting strength.

Additional research into this phenomenon may reveal a new element of Space Amoeba biology that can be enhanced to develop a new species-specific mutation.

descriptions.zh:
最近克隆的一支缇扬奇舰队被观察到正在进行交流，反复发出复杂的叫声。这些几乎无法察觉的声音似乎给附近的所有其他生物带来了安慰和平静。

对这种现象的进一步研究可能会揭示缇扬奇生物学的一个新元素，可以增强该元素以开发出特定物种的突变。
descriptions.en:
A recently cloned fleet of Tiyanki were observed communing together, repeatedly emitting a series of complex vocalizations. The barely detectable sounds seemed to bring comfort and calm to every other creature nearby.

Additional research into this phenomenon may reveal a new element of Tiyanki biology that can be enhanced to develop a species-specific mutation.

descriptions.zh:
我们注意到一些虚空虫在成熟时会形成小的囊肿状生长物。进一步观察表明，带有这些难看水泡的样本通常比它们的同类更具繁殖力。

对这种现象的进一步研究可能会揭示虚空虫生物学的一个新元素，可以增强该元素以开发出特定物种的突变。
descriptions.en:
We have noticed that some of our Voidworms tend to develop small cyst-like growths as they reach maturity. Further observation showed that specimens with these unsightly blisters are typically more fertile than their counterparts.

Additional research into this phenomenon may reveal a new element of Voidworm biology that can be enhanced to develop a species-specific mutation.

descriptions.zh:
由于过度投喂，我们记录到了一只克隆岩居兽发生了剧烈的呕吐。从其胃部喷出的消化液作为浓缩抛射体非常致命，即使在离开该生物的躯体很长时间后还保有放射性。

对这一现象的进一步研究揭示了岩居兽的生理学中有一种新的元素可以用来增强物种特有变异过程。
descriptions.en:
As a result of overfeeding, one of our cloned Cutholoids was recorded violently ejecting the contents of its stomach. The resulting digestive fluids proved to be quite deadly as a concentrated projectile, maintaining their radioactive qualities for significant time outside of the creature's body.

Additional research into this phenomenon may reveal a new element of Cutholoid biology that can be enhanced to develop a species-specific mutation.

descriptions.zh: 在战斗测试中，一些我们的晶体实体在被摧毁后完美地分裂成两半。这些碎片保持着重要的生命迹象，并继续存活了一段时间。
descriptions.en: In combat testing, a number of our Crystalline Entities have split perfectly in two after being destroyed. These fragmented halves have maintained vital life signs and continued to live for a short time.

descriptions.zh: 我们从缇扬奇族母身上提取的遗传物质为我们提供了一些独特的见解，这将使我们能够进行一项实验性突变项目，该项目可以应用于任何太空兽群。
descriptions.en: The genetic material we have recovered from the Tiyanki Matriarch has provided some unique insight that will allow us to proceed with an experimental mutation project that could be applied to any Space Fauna.

descriptions.zh: 我们从虚空孳孽身上提取的遗传物质为我们提供了一些独特的见解，这将使我们能够进行一项实验性突变项目，该项目可以应用于任何太空兽群。
descriptions.en: The genetic material we have recovered from the Voidspawn has provided some unique insight that will allow us to proceed with an experimental mutation project that could be applied to any Space Fauna.
